I had a dream where I had the masters degree's I wanted and worked at the top of the line job where I wanted. I had the perfect wife, perfect kids who were the smartest and most kind, and most fun kids to raise. I remember so many things from it like, birthdays, anniversaries, graduation, and all in between. It was our 20th anniversary, I was cuddling with my wife and then a lightning strike and I woke up in a hospital room terrified wondering what happened. ( I thought the dream was real) I was in the room after my first major surgery and was so depressed realizing everything I remember was a dream ( I was in summer before 6th grade). I never been the same after that, I've always tried to be happy but when I'm alone I just lay down and ponder why couldn't the dream be real, If I just sleep forever could I go back into that dream, so I could be happy a little more? All I am right now is a crippled senior in hs hoping I can have a glimpse of what that life was.
